description:
Natural-language exploration of Medical Affairs HCP 360, scientific engagement, unmet educational needs, and next-best scientific engagement. Grounded on governed Gold tables and metric views in _sa701.moe. All data is synthetic for demonstration.

Built with Databricks AI Dev Kit
sample_questions: What are the most common unmet educational needs for oncology HCPs?
Show engagement by channel and territory.
Why is a given HCP considered a high-priority scientific follow-up?
Which HCPs attended a congress, requested a follow-up, and have not yet received one?
Compare scientific-interest trends between academic and community oncologists.
Which territories have high patient need but low Medical Affairs engagement?
Identify high-influence HCPs with growing interest in real-world evidence but limited recent MSL engagement.
Which HCPs have not been contacted by an MSL in the past 90 days?
Which scientific topics are increasing fastest?
How many priority oncology HCPs were engaged in the last 90 days?
